rationale: Irregular shell material needs a coat while ordinary layers preserve role reading.

design_guidelines.artistic_direction: A polished shell mosaic with irregular facets and a clean role-coloured contour.
design_guidelines.concept_twist: A familiar armored shell surface is stretched into a continuously growing snake mosaic.
design_guidelines.body_strategy: Large facets reduce to a clear material cue at 4 cells, become legible by 6-7 cells, and x-tile across long turns without covering the head cue.
design_guidelines.asset_strategy: Request one production-quality 64-texel-per-cell coat whose x join remains seamless after every served transformation.

layer_plan: Body fallback remains readable without the atlas
Shell coat tiles above Body fallback

asset_plan.prompt: 1856x64 opaque x-seamless coat with irregular shell facets and no background.

risks: Facet clusters may expose a short repeat
